messages:
luca: Quick check — seeing intermittent 401s when using service-account impersonation in the Go SDK for streaming. Only happens on reconnects. Anyone seen this?
anya: Which flow are you using: JWT-based signed assertion, or an OIDC id_token? Also are you impersonating with generateAccessToken or generateIdToken?
luca: Impersonating with generateIdToken (we need an audience). We set target_audience to the API host. Main client calls succeed but when the stream reconnects it sometimes returns aud_mismatch / 401.
ryan: If the token's aud doesn't match what the upstream expects you'll get a 401. For streams the SDK tries to reuse the token until expiry; if the server expects a different aud on handshake the reauth will fail.
morgan: Yep. Two common gotchas: 1) The initial handshake used one aud (maybe api hostname) but reconnect is routed to a proxy expecting the internal service aud. 2) Token cache key ignores aud in some older SDK versions, so refresh returns a token with default aud.
luca: That matches. We route between regions and the proxy in eu-west uses audience https://inference-eu.redwood.ai while default is https://inference.redwood.ai.
anya: Short-term workaround: force the impersonation step to include the routed audience, or create separate impersonated tokens per region and attach correct token source for each route.
luca: Can you paste a minimal command we used? here's what we tried:```bash
curl -s -X POST https://iamcredentials.googleapis.com/v1/projects/-/serviceAccounts/sa-ops@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com:generateIdToken \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IMPERSONATOR_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"audience":"https://inference.redwood.ai","includeEmail":true}'
```
morgan: That looks fine. For the Go SDK, make sure your impersonation TokenSource sets TargetAudience and not just Scopes. Example (pseudo):```go
impTS := impersonate.NewTokenSource(ctx, impersonatedSA, impersonate.WithTargetAudience("https://inference-eu.redwood.ai"))
client := redwood.NewClient(redwood.WithTokenSource(impTS))
```
ryan: Also, watch refresh concurrency. If multiple goroutines try to refresh and the first refresh returns a token for default aud, but another refresh requests a different aud, you can end up with stale aud cached. Add small jitter or singleflight on refresh.
anya: If you're on v0.9.x of the SDK, upgrade — we added aud-aware cache keys in 0.10.0. If upgrade isn't possible, add a wrapper TokenSource that includes the aud in the cache key.
luca: Thanks. One more q: when should we use generateIdToken vs generateAccessToken for streams?
morgan: Use generateIdToken when the server requires an audience claim (ID token-based auth). Use generateAccessToken when the server validates OAuth scopes. Streams that accept JWT-based handshakes usually prefer id_token with aud set.
luca: Implemented region-aware token sources with small jitter on refresh and forced rotate on route change. Will run stress test.
anya: Nice. If you still see flakiness, capture the initial handshake logs + token aud claim (base64 decode) and drop them here.
devex-bot: infra-notify: rolling restart of devex-streamer-canaries at 10:14 UTC (for visibility) :rocket:
luca: Got it — running tests now, will report back. :thumbsup:
